scope: Linux native headless fixed-work research; no visible Steam or Windows performance conclusion.

benchmarkProtocol.statistics: Median of every available run, no trimming. sampleCount=1 is a diagnostic/control, not a three-run estimate.

evidencePolicy.routeComparison: Exact ordered equality of the complete ACTION and TURN entry arrays already extracted in metrics.json; this artifact stores the conclusion and entry counts, not raw log lines.
evidencePolicy.referenceSelection: Same fixture, node window and ordinary-GC/NoGC mode. Pressure DOP8/1 GB intentionally compares work against DOP4/4 GB; configurationMatches=false prevents treating that as an isolated speed comparison.
evidencePolicy.intermediateBuildIdentity: Intermediate labels represent uncommitted research stages, not immutable commit IDs. sourceCommit=null is deliberate; their exact combined builds cannot be reconstructed solely by checkout.

metricSemantics.byteUnit: bytes; configured GB is decimal 1,000,000,000 bytes
metricSemantics.totalElapsedMilliseconds: Request accumulated search time across all contributing solvers and included coordinator work; excludes full game startup/setup.
metricSemantics.totalWorkerAllocatedBytes: Search-thread allocation accounting across solvers; not total process allocation and not retained heap.
metricSemantics.totalGcPauseMilliseconds: Cumulative reported GC pause; do not call it maximum single pause.
metricSemantics.maxGcPauseMilliseconds: Observed maximum from runtime snapshots, not a trace-complete maximum. Baseline Smart reporting may include cumulative boundary pause, so legacy and repaired maxima are not strictly interchangeable.
metricSemantics.processVmHwmBytes: Linux process VmHWM sampled during the full launcher window, including startup/setup; not a solver-exclusive managed-memory peak.
metricSemantics.sampledPeakRssBytes: Maximum VmRSS observed by approximately 100 ms polling; can miss peaks between samples.
metricSemantics.gcLifecycle: null means instrumentation absent. Counters include explicit forced collect and NoGC API attempts/successes/restarts/losses; noGcRegionRolloverCount is a different legacy counter.
metricSemantics.gcLifecycleAttribution: ExclusiveSearchScope is frozen between actual exclusive admission and release. SharedProcessWindow may overlap ordinary-GC scopes; candidate1 predates explicit attribution.
metricSemantics.gcRuntimeSnapshot: Result-time process state; a reusable NoGC region can remain active after scope completion, so noGcEnds=0 does not imply leaked admission.
metricSemantics.headlessFrames: Headless frame gaps are deliberately omitted as evidence of player-visible stalls.
